items.title: November 09, 2026
items.summary: Anthos Config ManagementChangeAddressed multiple Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) by updating dependencies.ChangeUpgraded the git-sync dependency from v4.4.2 to v4.5.0 to pick up vulnerability fixes. For more details, see git-sync releases.ChangeUpgraded the Open Telemetry image from 0.152.0 to 0.159.0 to pick up vulnerability fixes. To understand the changes in each release, review the full changelog for opentelemetry-collector-contrib.Anti Money Laundering AIAnnouncementNew minor engine version released for the commercial line of business within the v004.009 version line (aml-commercial.default.v004.009.202610-000). This version extends support for the major engine version and includes no significant changes compared to the previous minor version.
